AboutAbout MDA

The Agency Built for Growth-Stage Businesses in Dubai

Master Digital Agency is a full-spectrum digital production studio operating under the DREXONYX brand. We build websites, produce media, develop brand identities, and deliver business-grade digital infrastructure for companies operating in Dubai's most competitive sectors.

We work with contractors, facility companies, manpower agencies, and professional services firms that need production-quality output on a fixed scope, fixed price, and defined timeline — no retainers, no uncertainty, no revision loops.

Every MDA client receives a written brief before work begins, approval gates before execution, and full asset ownership on delivery. We are built around one principle: businesses deserve agency work, not agency process.

1
Written Brief. Every project starts with a documented scope. No verbal commitments, no assumption of requirements.
2

3
Full Ownership. Source code, brand files, media assets — everything transfers to you on handover, no strings attached.

ProcessHow We Work

MDA operates on a four-gate production system. Every project moves through the same four gates in the same sequence — discovery, design, build, and launch. Nothing skips a gate. Nothing starts before the previous one closes.

This discipline is how we protect your budget, compress your timeline, and eliminate the rework that consumes most agency-client relationships before the product even ships.

"Every project has a brief. Every brief has a gate. Every gate has a sign-off."

01Discovery & Brief

We map your business goals, target market, and commercial opportunity in a structured discovery session. The outcome is a written brief that defines deliverables, confirms audience, and locks the project timeline. Nothing moves to design until the brief is finalised and signed. We also conduct a competitor audit and identify the key content pages your sector requires.

Business Brief Competitor Analysis Fixed Timeline Scoped Deliverables
02Design & Approval

Every touchpoint is crafted specifically for your brand — visual identity, UX wireframes, and messaging aligned to your audience. We present three design directions before any build begins. Nothing proceeds to development without your written approval. Design rounds are time-boxed so the project stays on schedule.

Wireframes 3 Design Directions Approval Gate Visual Identity
03Build & Execute

We execute across all disciplines simultaneously — frontend development, content setup, and media creation delivered on brief and on schedule. Parallel execution compresses timelines without quality trade-offs. Weekly status updates keep you informed at every stage of the production cycle.

Development QA & Testing Weekly Updates Parallel Execution
04Launch & Handover

We manage the full go-live — DNS, hosting configuration, and deployment to your infrastructure. On launch day you receive the complete codebase, all creative assets, and a written handover brief. Every MDA project includes 30 days of post-launch support as standard at no extra cost.

Full Handover DNS & Hosting 30-Day Support Asset Ownership

30-Day Support Guarantee

Every MDA project includes a 30-day post-launch support period as standard. Bugs are fixed, changes are handled, and the site is monitored — at no additional cost — for the full first month after go-live. Most issues are resolved within one business day. Premium projects include 90 days.

Results, Not Reports

We measure success against the original brief — not against activity metrics. Every project closes with live, working output deployed and confirmed against its stated commercial objectives. The brief is the contract. Deliverables that miss the brief are reworked, not invoiced.

▸Deliverables signed off against the original brief, not hours logged
▸Off-brief output is reworked at no additional cost
▸No dashboard reports — the live site is the evidence
Output vs. brief · Rework if off-brief · No activity KPIs
